# Issue 75 independent proactive visual QA

Reviewed [#75 — Resume and manage account-owned projects without losing lifecycle truth](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/75).

Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**. Date: **2026-10-25**. Baseline/current HEAD: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. Review only: no product, specification, Git, or GitHub changes. Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence were preserved; `git diff --name-only -- frontend` was empty. This report owns only `issue-75/`.

**Verdict:** useful native mock journeys work, but visual acceptance is not established. **0 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 3 LOW** findings. The most consequential visible problems are allowed titles overflowing the phone viewport, absent scene identification, incomplete active-work deletion warning, and undersized phone rename targets.

## Purpose and evidence boundary

The user job is to identify the right saved scene, understand what is saved, continue at its valid destination, rename it safely, or deliberately release its slot. Returning to an existing scene should not require remembering filenames or guessing whether deletion stops a running charge.

Fresh Chromium captures use isolated contexts, `127.0.0.1:4375`, DPR 1, 100% zoom, muted audio, fake-media flags and no physical devices. Exact browser/Node versions are in [environment.json](environment.json). [metrics.json](metrics.json) contains DOM geometry/fonts, capture names, action results and synthetic service calls; [followup.json](followup.json) contains the long-title, blur-save and native resume proof. No full suite was run.

Native primary evidence: real application with default mock facade and native IndexedDB. Registration/verification and upload of the repository's synthetic MP4 were seeded through the public facade. Rename, menu, delete, Cancel and Continue were then driven through rendered controls. This proves mock UI behavior, not real upload/backend operation. EN/RU empty and two-row long-title lists were inspected. Native delete committed and changed capacity from 2/2 to 1/2. The follow-up resumed the saved draft to `/new`, retaining its renamed title and source, with an explicit Get exact quote control.

Synthetic supplemental evidence: the existing `workspace-state-visual.html` harness supplies six lifecycle rows, loading/list error, rename error, known delete failure and unknown delete outcome. Its capacity is deliberately **6/6**; this is fixture data, not a product capacity defect. It is not proof of native multi-state persistence, candidate recovery, correct billing, or routing of those fixture rows. The active-processing dialog finding combines actual screen behavior for a `preparing` row with source evidence; no real job was deleted in that case.

All **32** delivered PNGs were opened with `view_image`. Capture scripts and [screenshots.json](screenshots.json) are reproducibility artifacts. One initial screenshot race was corrected by waiting for the native list loading text to disappear. The raw `renamePersisted: []` sample in metrics was taken immediately after reload, before rows loaded; the later settled `native-renamed-en-short.png` and successful menu/delete selection of that persisted title provide the evidence. That premature sample is not treated as a defect.

## Contract and visual authority

Read the issue snapshot (`contracts/issue-75.md`, zero discussion comments), active Flow11 and shared/source authorities, HANDOFF/SDD, Ponytail, spec-task-review and both design skills including app-screen guidance. Current Flow11 resolves the old issue's grapheme/activity-open notes for the mock; production authority remains explicitly open.

Applicable source pairs inspected:

| Source | Destination and observed map | Adaptation/boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `../affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/button/Clean/button-clean.md.txt` lines 289–376 + `Light/01-initial.png` | Native button semantics; secondary white, radius 6, literal small multilayer shadow, desktop Continue 24px / Mabry 500 12/16, icon actions 32px | Mabry replaces source Inter; phone Continue 48px / 16/24. Source small size is compliant appearance but challenged for frequent-action usability below. |
| `../affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/profile-menu/Clean/profile-menu-clean.md.txt` lines 312–418 + `Light/01-initial.png` | Radix dropdown; white, radius 10 framing, compact destructive action with outlined Lucide icon | Actual project row/menu/input/dialog are derivatives, not an Affect Table/Card/Dialog component. Product readable danger/focus adaptations apply. The actual menu shadow is a simpler derivative; pixel-exact source fidelity is not asserted. |

Both Mabry Pro 400 and 500 reported loaded after `document.fonts.ready`; measured controls computed Mabry Pro. Desktop row height 88px; phone rows about 133px. The page has a calm flat list, clear noun heading, no invented filters, sharing controls, grid cards or metrics. Title, state and activity are legible for ordinary short names. Missing visual scene identity is the larger hierarchy issue than decorative styling.

## Expected versus actual

| AC/state | Expected | Fresh actual and evidence | Assessment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AC-01 empty/capacity | Owned list/current slot count; exact empty region | Empty 0/2; native seeded full 2/2; native deletion 1/2. Empty has extra instructional sentence. `native-empty-en-desktop`, `native-empty-ru-phone`, `native-deleted-en-short` | Bounded functional pass; QA-75-06/07 |
| AC-02 resume | Valid current destination without authorizing processing | Native draft Continue opens `/new`, retained source/title, explicit quote action. `native-resume-draft-en-desktop` | Draft branch confirmed; other resolver branches not run |
| AC-03 rename | Enter success, blur autosave, Escape cancellation; errors retain value | Native Enter survived reload; blur saved and survived reload; Escape restored prior title; blank Enter showed field error; synthetic failure retained editable attempted text. `native-rename-validation-en-short`, `native-renamed-en-short`, `fixture-projects-rename-error-ru-phone` | Bounded pass, not duplicate-event/race proof |
| AC-04 delete | Correct identity, Cancel/Delete, truthful unknown/error/success, impact warning | Native dialog/title, Cancel focus return and committed deletion work; synthetic known/unknown states stay distinct. Missing queued/running warning. `native-delete-en-short`, `fixture-projects-delete-error-ru-phone`, `fixture-default-ru-phone`, active dialog below | Partial; QA-75-03 |
| AC-05 responsive/activity | EN/RU, no horizontal overflow, phone targets, correct activity | Both locales at 1440×900/700, 390×844 and mixed fixtures at 767/768; long native title overflows; rename 32×48. Activity shown; ordering/event dedupe not independently proven | QA-75-01/04; lifecycle evidence gap |
| AC-VIS-01 row anatomy | Thumbnail/fallback, saved progress, title, Continue/menu | Text-only rows with enum state badges; no media slot/fallback. `native-two-long-en-desktop`, `fixture-mixed-ru-desktop` | QA-75-02 |
| Loading/error | Flat placeholders, honest localized error and Retry | Synthetic loading is plain text, no retained final row geometry; list error has clear Retry. `fixture-projects-list-pending-ru-phone`, `fixture-projects-list-error-ru-phone` | Loading reference gap; error appearance inspected |

## Findings

### QA-75-01 — MEDIUM — Allowed long titles widen the phone page and hide lifecycle truth

**Class/status:** confirmed implementation defect. **AC:** AC-05, AC-VIS-01; Flow11 AC-F11-12.

**Reproduce:** seed/upload a valid project title with about 98 graphemes (the supplied follow-up uses `Очень длинное название ` plus 75 Cyrillic letters), visit My projects at 390×844. Also reproduced with the English long title in both UI locales.

**Expected:** one-line ellipsis, accessible complete title, visible state/actions within the 16px gutters. **Actual:** viewport 390px, document `scrollWidth=1186`; main cell 1169.94px; state badge begins at x=1143.89. The horizontal overflow is real DOM geometry, not screenshot scaling. The full-page PNG is intentionally wider than the viewport and shows the escaped content.

**Source:** [ProjectsScreen.css](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/projects/ProjectsScreen.css:77) gives the main cell min-width 0 but no bounded phone width; at line 254 the row changes to a column. The title's ellipsis at line 89 cannot constrain that intrinsic main-cell width.

**Impact:** a supported title pushes the status out of view, weakens scene identification and creates horizontal navigation. **Recommendation:** constrain the phone main/title flex containers to the row's available width while allowing the title to shrink. Preserve accessible full text and trailing controls. **Next validation:** 100-grapheme Latin/Cyrillic/emoji names at 390/767/768 in EN/RU; assert document width equals viewport and state remains visible.

![Native long Cyrillic title overflow](evidence/native-cyrillic-long-en-phone.png)

### QA-75-02 — MEDIUM — Rows omit the required scene thumbnail or unavailable fallback

**Class/status:** confirmed implementation defect. **AC:** AC-VIS-01 and scope; Flow11 §4.4 / AC-F11-02.

**Reproduce:** open any native saved draft; inspect the mixed-state fixture as a supplemental check. **Expected:** a small fixed media slot, with a quiet Preview unavailable fallback if no thumbnail exists. **Actual:** every measured row has zero image/video/canvas elements and no media slot/fallback text; the row JSX only renders title, enum badge and last activity. No thumbnail generation is required to confirm the missing fallback.

**Source:** [ProjectsScreen.tsx](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/projects/ProjectsScreen.tsx:603), Flow11 lines 190/198/666. **Impact:** creators must identify video scenes from names alone; similar filenames become costly to distinguish. ## What worked, critique and gaps

The flat list reads coherently for ordinary titles. State is text, not color alone. Mabry loads correctly; the heading/body hierarchy is calm. EN/RU short labels fit the breakpoint matrix. Long project identity wraps inside the delete dialog, ordinary Cancel/Delete controls are present, and native Cancel returns focus to the correct action trigger. Known failure retains the dialog; unknown deletion offers status reconciliation and does not claim success or free capacity. Native successful deletion removes the chosen row and changes the count. Native validation focuses the input and retains the attempted value; synthetic save failure keeps the attempted text editable.

Independent design critique: retain the light palette, Mabry and compact rows; spend the existing space on scene recognition and meaningful progress. A 12px stage chip beside an editable title should not bear the whole recovery story. The timestamp currently takes the second row while the actual job state gets a small badge; a succinct saved-progress line would serve the user better once the authoritative data exists. The unknown-delete fixture repeats nearly the same warning in two stacked notices; consolidating the repeated message is an optional clarity improvement, not an additional counted defect.

Coverage gaps are material: no full lifecycle resolver matrix, first-unaccepted-turn/candidate recovery, zero-turn prior-output preservation, late deletion/completion races, no-replayed-charge invariant, account switching, purchased 10-slot lifecycle, stale/partial list and capacity failures, thumbnail service, native background updates, activity ordering/deduplication, duplicate Enter+blur instrumentation, save-unknown reconciliation, true 200% browser zoom, forced colors, screen reader, reduced-motion timing, physical phone or software-keyboard occlusion. Desktop short and phone error/dialog states are represented, but not every state in every locale/size. The fixture loading screen shows plain loading text instead of specified flat final-geometry placeholders; no native slow-refresh evidence was collected, so broader stale-layout acceptance remains open.

No production backend, external provider, retention/physical erasure, real media capture, real charge/refund or deployed behavior was tested. These results neither reopen the issue nor revise its recorded acceptance.
